Palmier

PalmierVideo editor built for AI

5.0 (1 review)

AI Engineer

Palmier is where we cut our launch film, a one-minute black-and-white "to the crazy ones" piece for MakerMap. It's built for AI video, so turning generated shots, voice-over and music into one story took an afternoon instead of a week, and making a shorter cut for X and YouTube was quick. For a team without a video editor, that made a real film possible.

MakerMap is one person shipping many times a day, and Vercel makes that painless. The site, 30+ API routes, the daily crons, the share cards drawn on the fly and the Blob store that holds every profile all live in one place. We deploy in under a minute, and a bad deploy rolls back instantly.

Typesafe

TypesafeThe first (public) System One Model

5.0 (1 review)

Typesafe's Jev model powers MakerMap's matching. Every night it reads makers' intros and works out who has the most in common: same stage, same interests, same roots. That's what's behind "The most in common · Picked by Jev" and the reasons on each match card. It feels like common sense, not keyword search.
